---
title: What is next?
description: Fixes, Policy v2 and outside signers.
order: 9
---

- **Fixes waiting on the next rotation.** Because the new machines are sealed, fixes made after the seal can't be copied onto them. The next set is planned with a way to take a release the chain itself has approved.
- **Policy v2.** Planned for the next policy: a price band, a maximum distance from the exchange's mark price on every order, checked by each signer on its own price feed. And a cap on how many orders a key can sign per second.
- **Outside signers.** Another rotation comes before signers we don't run can join.
